steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Tho Long, an earth element dragon, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: digging the food up with its claws; (3) EAT: a big chomp; (4) EAT: chewing, back plates glowing. Row 2: (5) EAT: curled up content; (6) PLAY: burrowing half into the ground; (7) PLAY: bursting up out of the ground with rocks; (8) PLAY: leaping high. Row 3: (9) PLAY: tail spin flinging pebbles; (10) PLAY: landing on all fours; (11) PLAY: roaring happily; (12) REFUSE food: turning its head and huffing dust. Row 4: (13) PETTED: eyes closed, plates relaxing; (14) WAVE hello: waving a claw; (15) SAD: curled up, head down; (16) ANGRY: back plates raised, roaring.
